fusions.name: Still, Then Sudden
fusions.desc: Rakes the target for 30 damage that is always a critical hit and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Tail-Whip Spin
fusions.desc: Whips your tail round, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Dropped Tail
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 30% for 8 seconds, and you finish 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Sun on the Scales
fusions.desc: By day, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
